comment: Marjan Urekar's 2001 redraw of the Serge ring modulator (CA3080 plus PNP differential pair), +/-12V; only U1, U2 and Q1-Q3 carry designators, so the passives are listed by quantity.
rows: X trim, Y trim, diode bias and Q3 base-to-ground resistors; no designators drawn
X trim divider, X AC input divider, RM OUT series
X DC IN and X AC IN to ground
X AC input series; U2 feedback
Y DC input, initial amplitude, Y AC series, Y AC to ground
Q1 and Q2 bases to ground
U2 feedback; added to prevent oscillation, not in the original
X AC IN and Y AC IN coupling
original was matched PNP pair 2N4196; use matched PNPs
